senses.definition: n.pr.m. a hero of David 1 Ch 11:44, Σαμαθα, Σαμμα (cf. OSem. שמע on scarab ClGann JAs 1883 Fev.-Mars, 135, No. 9; also on seal from Megiddo (1904), cf. Kau Mitth. u. Nachr. DPV, 1904, 2 ff.).
